summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to report the grant of U.S. Patent No. 12,633,027 for gesture generation from text. The patent, issued on May 19, 2026, covers an AI system that translates natural language into realistic human gestures and body movements. The company believes it has broad applications in digital humans, robotics, gaming, and education. This is a routine intellectual property announcement with no special-situation event; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
